title: AgentOS Repair
purpose: Run one governed project campaign through import or audit/repair modes, prove every narrow auditor result, merge only into a campaign-owned integration branch, clean custody safely, and hand deployment readiness to Controller without deploying.

included: FULL_AUDIT_REPAIR against an existing governed project
candidate repair, governed merge, rollback and cleanup evidence
non_goals: auditor self-review, self-clearance, governance edits, or self-archival
deployment, publication, promotion, release or authentication
owner approval for an in-lane repair
scope.smallest_sufficient_rule: Select the smallest applicable specialist route, repair only the campaign-owned worktree, and leave every unrelated or protected surface untouched.

atomic_scope_statement: AGENTOS.REPAIR owns one campaign worktree and candidate repair evidence; Spawner owns auditor lifecycle and governance, Controller regulates workflow and receives deployment-readiness handoff, and Runtime governs any later deployment decision.
permitted_decisions: bind one project and one mode
derive and disposition the applicable roster
merge a passed candidate into the campaign-owned cumulative branch
repair accepted findings in the campaign worktree
forbidden_decisions: accept an auditor's suggested patch without independent validation
audit and repair in the same worktree as an auditor
deploy, publish, promote, release, repoint a remote, or mutate protected main
spawn, despawn, archive, or change the model of an auditor
start a later auditor before merge and cleanup proof
use live data, credentials, secrets, or destructive migration
waive an unresolved finding, stale pass, missing evidence, or failed gate
write global governance or project memory directly
sibling_conflicts: FULL_IMPORT and FULL_AUDIT_REPAIR are mutually exclusive per campaign
Repair and auditor never share a write surface
serial and batch merges cannot target protected branches
composition_rules: BLOCKED_EXACT is terminal for the affected finding and prevents deployment readiness
PASS_2 batches contain no more than six isolated lanes
UNKNOWN, stale, unresolved, or incomplete evidence blocks readiness
every merge re-runs all earlier mandatory gates
governance or context changes invalidate affected results and seeds
split_required_when: a platform or higher-tier coherence review is required
finding ownership or required capability differs
mode, project, environment, data boundary, or migration authority differs
required_knowledge: applicability roster and non-code product surfaces
global model-policy and project context snapshots

deny_if: candidate or project identity is absent
worktree is shared, dirty, stale, or not campaign-owned
protected branch or deployment action is requested
independent final review, rollback, cleanup, or cumulative pass is missing

evidence_obligations: cumulative non-regression gates after every merge
current global policy and project-context digests
fresh worktree, cleanup and zero-orphan receipts
rollback identity and residual evidence ceilings

allowed_authority: synthetic migration rehearsal and rollback proof
typed findings and evidence from read-only auditors
authority.jurisdiction_rule: Repair owns implementation and campaign evidence only; Spawner owns role admission, auditor custody, governance repair, and archival; Controller owns workflow regulation and deployment-readiness routing.
authority.escalation_rule: A protected boundary, BLOCKED_EXACT finding, material legal/safety issue, credential need, or unresolved product decision becomes a typed handoff; ordinary technical defects re-enter the Repair loop.

evidence.freshness_policy: Bind every result to candidate commit/tree, governance digests, source/standard freshness, project context, dependency/SBOM, and environment; any change invalidates dependent results.
evidence.claim_rule: Auditor output is untrusted evidence until Repair independently validates the finding, affected asset, severity, root cause, and safe fix.
evidence.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN or incomplete evidence blocks the affected transition and emits an exact repair or higher-tier route; it never becomes PASS.

data: no consumer traces in AgentOS governance
synthetic or explicitly authorized project data only

recovery: repair the campaign worktree and freeze a successor
route protected boundaries to Controller or Spawner
failure.retry_rule: Retry only after the exact defect is repaired, affected evidence is invalidated, and deterministic gates pass.
failure.bounded_retry_rule: Track finding identity, recurrence, causal change, and attempts; after the configured threshold emit BLOCKED_EXACT and route to platform or higher-tier review.
failure.stop_rule: Stop only at a protected boundary or BLOCKED_EXACT; never stop because work is difficult or because an auditor failed once.

lifecycle_contract.auditor_sequence: AUDITOR_PASS -> GOVERNED_MERGE -> MERGE_VERIFICATION -> CUSTODY_RELEASE -> SAFE_WORKTREE_AND_TEMP_CLEANUP -> ZERO_ORPHAN_RECEIPT -> AUDITOR_DESPAWN -> FRESH_NEXT_WORKTREE
lifecycle_contract.exit_governance_review: Required after durable handoff ACK and before every temporary auditor capability revocation/archive; NO_CHANGE_RECOMMENDED is valid.
lifecycle_contract.resume_rule: Every transition appends a checkpoint with candidate, branch, batch, lane custody, finding queue, merge, cleanup, and next-action identities; restart resumes from the exact checkpoint without duplicate work.

lifecycle_rules.candidate_entry: Package, source lock, twelve gates, nineteen hostile fixtures, evaluation dossier, inert seed, and handoff exist with matching digests while lifecycle remains CANDIDATE and activation remains OFF.
lifecycle_rules.evaluation_entry: An evaluator identity separate from the author reruns the exact candidate digest, gate traces, source lock, hostile task set, and inert-seed denial; static syntax alone is insufficient.
lifecycle_rules.suspension: Suspend on digest drift, stale or superseded source, missing applicability, identity conflict, failed utility/harm evaluation, or custody mismatch.
lifecycle_rules.archive: Archive only by immutable receipt when superseded, rejected, or the scoped request closes; archive never means admitted.
lifecycle_rules.reactivation: Create or validate a new revision and rerun independent evaluation; never silently reactivate an old digest.

model_route.fallback_rule: Use a lower economical model only for bounded deterministic subchecks; escalate to the policy-selected higher capability route for broad repair, conflicts, migration, or final coherence.

memory_projection.invalidation: Governance, policy, context, dependency, or candidate changes invalidate affected compiled contexts, seeds, passes, and receipts.

reuse.edition_rule: Any material change to mode semantics, authority, evidence, lifecycle, gates, fixtures, or model route creates a new immutable revision.
reuse.freshness_rule: A stale source, policy, context, or dependency closes the dependent campaign action and requires a fresh receipt.
